newsitem.title: USA: PSE to trade options on Taiwan stock index Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: PSE to trade options on Taiwan stock index Jan 9.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange said it planned to trade options on the Dow Jones Taiwan Stock Index .XDT starting January 9.
Strike prices will be set at 2-1/2-point intervals for near term options and five-point intervals for longer term options.
The options, which will be cash-settled, will have initial expirations in February, March, June and September.
The index is a broad-based, capitalization-weighted index of 117 Taiwan stocks that represent more than 80 percent of the Taiwan stock exchange's market capitalization.
The index comprises six market sectors -- basic materials, cyclical consumer, noncylical consumer, financial, industrial and technology.
The options will have European-style exercise, meaning they can be exercised only at expiration.
The options have been allocated to Hull Trading Co.
The Chicago Mercantile Exchange has said it plans to trade futures and futures-options on the index beginning January 8.
